attributes.residual: Naming confidence is deliberately uneven and is marked as such in the source comments rather than smoothed over. GC-verified: exp, class_unlock, last_alttype, and the four *_add fields (see evidence.psaveatts-record-identification.20260831.v1 for the four-way corroboration and the permutation argument). attributes.scope: src/game/ui/select.c only; no include/game/*.h edit. Two commits. (1) ClassStatSlot renamed to the Xbox PDB record P_SAVE_ATTS with all six fields spelled real -- exp, health, fight_add, armor_add, magic_add, speed_add -- replacing field_08/0C/10/14 at the four offsetof sites in update_class_attr. (2) A new file-local P_SAVE_HEAD view models the head of the persistent save block at Player+0x0A80, unblocking the three pad_0A88 sites that tested `*(u16*)(pl + 2700)`: they now read offsetof(Player, name) + offsetof(P_SAVE_HEAD, class_unlock), the project's established two-term idiom. The expslot base likewise became offsetof(Player, name) + sizeof(P_SAVE_HEAD) + sel * sizeof(P_SAVE_ATTS).
